scripts.build: bun run backend:build && bun run --filter @rss-reader/desktop build
scripts.package: bun run build && bun run scripts/package.ts
scripts.test: bun test && cd backend && go test ./...
scripts.backend:build: mkdir -p apps/desktop/resources/bin && cd backend && go build -o ../apps/desktop/resources/bin/rss-backend ./cmd/desktop
scripts.server:build: bun run --filter @rss-reader/desktop build:renderer && mkdir -p apps/desktop/resources/bin apps/desktop/resources/web && cp -R apps/desktop/dist-renderer/. apps/desktop/resources/web/ && cd backend && go build -o ../apps/desktop/resources/bin/rss-server ./cmd/server
scripts.server:dev: bun run --filter @rss-reader/desktop build:renderer && cd backend && go run ./cmd/server
